# Quickstart
Source: https://example.com/docs/quickstart

Install the CLI with `pip install example-cli`. Run `example init` to
scaffold a new project. If the install step fails, look up ERROR_CODE_100
in the troubleshooting guide.
# Authentication
Source: https://example.com/docs/guides/auth

Configure your API key via the `EXAMPLE_API_KEY` environment variable.
If requests return ERROR_CODE_401, your key is invalid or expired.
# API Reference
Source: https://example.com/docs/reference/api

The API returns ERROR_CODE_500 for unexpected server errors. Retry with
exponential backoff before giving up.
